# Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader: combat and Force feats (novel, read in full)

- **Book:** *Star Wars: Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader*
- **Author:** James Luceno (Del Rey, 2005)
- **Continuity:** Legends (Expanded Universe). Set right after Revenge of the Sith (about 19 BBY).
- **Source file:** `[local path]` (5,876 lines, an IRC text copy). Every line was read in order.
- **Line numbers** point to that file. Each paragraph is one line, so one line number can cover a long paragraph.
- **Structure:** Part I, THE OUTER RIM SIEGES (ch. 1-8, L15-878), Part II, THE EMPEROR'S EMISSARY (ch. 9-16, L879-1824), Part III, IMPERIAL CENTER (ch. 17-35, L1825-4158), Part IV, KASHYYYK (ch. 36-49, L4159-5474), Epilogue (ch. 50-54, L5475-5876).
- **Spelling in the scan:** OCR errors appear in the file: "Star-stone", "Jambe Luand" (L2581, meaning "Jambe Lu and"), "Lambe" for Jambe (5 times), "Derail" for Deran Nalual. Quotes below copy the file as it is.
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch23
- **Not in this book:** Fy-Tor-Ana does not appear anywhere in the file (searched by name). She has no feats here. No other Jedi beyond those listed below fight on-page.
- Quotes are kept short for citation. Check the file for full context.

---

## 1. Feats in chapter order

Format: **ID. [Part/Ch., Lines] Who: what it shows.** Then a short quote with its line number.

### Part I: The Outer Rim Sieges (Murkhana)

**F1. [I/1, L47-49] Roan Shryne: precognition / Force vision.** While dropping into Murkhana, Shryne sees a forest world, defenders, ships, and a lone figure tearing aside a black curtain. This comes true on Kashyyyk (see F64).
> "Shryne knew he had stepped out of time, into some truth beyond reckoning." (L49)

**F2. [I/1, L73] Shryne: long-range Force sensing.** He senses three Jedi in other gunships during a combat drop.
> "Stretching out with the Force, Shryne found them, faint echoes confirming that all three were still alive." (L73)

**F3. [I/2, L143, L155] Shryne, Bol Chatak, Olee Starstone: Force-assisted jump.** About a 10 m drop from a hovering gunship under fire.
> "Using the Force to oversee his fall, he landed in a crouch on the compacted sand, as did Chatak and Starstone, if less expertly." (L155)

**F4. [I/3, L299-315] Shryne (with commando Climber and a spec-three): lightsaber skill, bolt deflection, time dilation.** Three of them against 12 sentries, mercs, Koorivar, and 3 battle droids. Four go down to opening blaster shots. Shryne cuts down the rest, including a droid.
> "Moments expanded, allowing him to perceive each individual energy bolt, each flick of a vibroblade." (L301)
> "almost thirty years of training had honed his instincts and turned his body into an instrument of tremendous speed and power." (L301)

**F5. [I/3, L319-327] Shryne: reflex speed.** After he is disarmed, he kicks his spinning hilt into Climber's hand in time for Climber to impale an attacker.
> "Shryne moved in a blur" (L327)

**F6. [I/3, L331] Shryne: weak telekinesis (a negative feat).** He cannot push a wrecked battle droid off Climber and needs help.
> "Years back, he would have been able to manage it alone, but no longer." (L331)

**F7. [I/5, L457] Shryne, Chatak, Starstone: skirmish wins.** They fight their way through droids and mercenaries.
> "won their skirmishes when evasion wasn't an option." (L457)

**F8. [I/5, L503-525] Shryne and Chatak: danger sense.** Both sense the Order 66 ambush before it is sprung. Starstone does not.
> "I thought I was the only one sensing it," Chatak said quietly. (L505)

**F9. [I/6, L655] Shryne, Chatak, Starstone: Force speed.**
> "using the speed granted by the Force to put kilometers between themselves and their new enemy." (L655)

**F10. [I/6, L679] Shryne and Chatak: Force sensing of deaths.** They reach out for Master Saras Loorne's group and feel nothing. Loorne and two Knights were "ambushed and killed" by clones (L721).
> "he stretched out with the Force, but no reverberations attended his call." (L679)

**F11. [I/8, L831-833] Chatak, Starstone, Shryne: acrobatic leaps.** They frog-leap across the jagged pylons of a demolished bridge. Shryne nearly falls, and Starstone catches him.
> "A last-moment grab from Starstone was all that saved him from a plunge into the waves." (L833)

### Part II: The Emperor's Emissary (Murkhana, Vader's debut)

**F12. [II/11, L1035] Shryne: telepathic contact.** Across a crowd of prisoners about 50 m away. Starstone answers first.
> "He called to them through the Force" (L1035)

**F13. [II/11, L1127-1143] Darth Vader vs Ion Team (4 clone commandos): blaster deflection, redirection.** They fire on him. He sends bolts back through two visors and cuts two commandos in half. A deflected bolt hits Climber's leg as Climber and the fourth commando run (both are captured later, L1199).
> "Spreading out, they fired, but not a single bolt made it past Vader's blade." (L1141)
> "Deflected bolts went straight through the helmet visors of two of the commandos" (L1141)

**F14. [II/11, L1153-1185] Vader vs Bol Chatak: lightsaber duel (Vader's first on-page duel, at his worst).** Vader wins by force and size. Chatak is faster and lands a cut on his prosthetic forearm.
> "Vader, by contrast, was clumsy, and his strikes were mostly vertical." (L1169)
> "He was, however, a full head taller than Chatak and incredibly powerful." (L1169)
> "But Vader scarcely reacted to the hit" (L1171)
> "Vader had simply beaten her into submission" (L1185). He takes her sword arm at the elbow and then beheads her.

**F15. [II/11, L1193] Shryne: hiding his Force presence. Vader: Force sensing.** Shryne hides his presence and Vader's gaze passes over him, but Vader picks out the untrained-at-hiding Starstone.
> "There were techniques for concealing one's Force abilities, and Shryne employed them." (L1193)

**F16. [II/12, L1239-1243] Chatak and Starstone: Force persuasion.** Chatak hides her lightsaber from guards for about four weeks. Starstone keeps the beacon transceiver the same way.
> "Force persuasion," Starstone said quietly. (L1239)

**F17. [II/12, L1295-1309] Shryne: mind trick on a clone trooper, relayed to his squad.** The trooper repeats each line to his comrades, and the two Jedi walk off a prison-transport ramp.
> "There's no reason to detain us," he said. (L1297) / "There's no reason to detain them," he told his comrades. (L1299)

**F18. [II/15, L1601] Vader: telekinesis (Force grip and throw).**
> "Stretching out his right hand, Vader yanked Garrulan off his feet and carried him through the foyer and into the office" (L1601)

**F19. [II/16, L1703, L1725] Vader: reading people, sensing the Jedi.** He sees through the Dead Ringer decoys right away and names the real escape craft.
> "The Jedi are aboard that craft." (L1725)

**F20. [II/16, L1783-1823] Vader: piloting (fails).** Flying a black Jedi interceptor, he closes on the CloakShape, but Brudi Gayn's booster-ring jump gets away.
> "Allowing the interceptor to power down, Vader gazed in defeat at the distant starfield." (L1817)

### Part III: Imperial Center

**F21. [III/18, L2059-2061, L2305] Shryne: mind trick on smuggler Skeck.** Captain Jula, his Force-sensitive mother, notices it.
> "You make one more attempt at using Force persuasion on any members of my crew, and I may forget that I'm your mother." (L2305)

**F22. [III/20, L2221] Jula (untrained Force-sensitive): sensing across a sector.**
> "It's because of our Force connection that I brought the Dancer to this sector. I sensed you, Roan." (L2221)

**F23. [III/19, L2087] Vader: Force scream (backstory from the end of ROTS).**
> "had been reduced to scrap by a scream that had torn from Vader's scorched throat on his learning of his wife's death." (L2087)

**F24. [III/19, L2099] Vader: strength or telekinesis in a fit of rage.**
> "Vader lifted the injured arm, hurling the med droid halfway across the laboratory." (L2099)

**F25. [III/21, L2315] Sidious: Force healing / life support.** On the trip back from Mustafar.
> "recalled using all his powers, and all the potions and devices contained in his medkit, to minister to Anakin's hopelessly blistered body" (L2315)

**F26. [III/21, L2359] Sidious: precognition / sensing.** He senses a coming call before the hologram appears.
> "Alert to a mild disturbance in the Force, he swung toward the throne room holoprojector a moment before" (L2359)

**F27. [III/24, L2699, L2711] Sidious and Vader: backstory feats (Vader's memory of ROTS).** Sidious's lightning throws Mace Windu out a window. Vader duels the Temple swordmaster and beheads Masters.
> "Sith lightning hurling an astonished Mace Windu through what had been a window" (L2699)
> "pitting his blade against that of swordmaster Cin Drallig, beheading some of the very Masters who had instructed him in the ways of the Force" (L2711)

**F28. [III/24, L2759] Vader: unconscious telekinetic outburst.** His anguish knocks over the Temple library plinths.
> "tore an anguished moan from him that toppled the rest of the plinths as if they were dominoes" (L2759)

**F29. [III/26, L2955-2991] Shryne, Starstone, Siadem Forte, Iwo Kulka vs reactivated battle droids on Jaguada's moon: bolt deflection.** Shryne uses Klossi Anno's dead Master's lightsaber. The other three cover the slicers.
> "Redirecting a flurry of bolts, Shryne reduced six droids to shrapnel." (L2977)
> "We can handle the droidekas," Forte assured him. (L2971)

**F30. [III/27, L3077] Shryne: sensing someone approach.**
> "was kneeling in meditation when he sensed Starstone approaching the cabin." (L3077)

**F31. [III/28, L3233] Sidious: reading Force currents (strategic foresight).**
> "attuned to the currents of the Force. Currents linking Vader and Murkhana, and now Zar and Murkhana." (L3233)

**F32. [III/33, L3869-3875] Vader: suit sensors plus Force sensing.** He senses Shryne hidden behind him.
> "Sensing a subtle presence, he stopped." (L3875)

**F33. [III/33, L3901-3903] Shryne (blaster only) vs Vader: evasion / precognition.** Shryne dodges every bolt Vader deflects back at him.
> "by jinking and jagging Shryne managed to evade each parry." (L3903)

**F34. [III/33, L3905] Vader: prosthetic leap. Shryne: Force speed.**
> "Vader leapt, his powerful prosthetic legs carrying him to the top of a broad but short flight of steps in time to see Shryne sprint across the bridge at Jedi speed" (L3905)

**F35. [III/33, L3907-3909] Vader: bare-hand blaster deflection (Tutaminis-style).** He blocks Shryne's repeated fire with his open hand, saber held to the side.
> "Holding his lightsaber to one side, he raised his right hand to turn the blaster bolts." (L3907)
> "Clearly astonished, Shryne remained on one knee" (L3909)

**F36. [III/33, L3911] Vader: chained leaps** (steps, then bridge, then just short of the rampart).
> "Vader's final leap landed him just short of the rampart." (L3911)

**F37. [III/34, L3973-3985] Vader: guided lightsaber throw that beats Shryne's telekinesis.** Vader throws his lit saber from under a closing blast gate. It arcs over the crowd past the landing platform, comes back, hits Fang Zar (fatal, L4053) and Jula (wounded), then strikes the gate. Shryne tries to push it off course with the Force and fails.
> "Vader hurled his ignited lightsaber through the air." (L3975)
> "Calling on the Force, he tried to influence the course of the lightsaber, but either the Force wasn't with him or Vader's Force abilities were overpowering his." (L3981)

**F38. [III/34, L3989] Shryne: sensing Vader's emotion through a sealed gate.**
> "Rooted in place Shryne could sense Vader on the far side of the gate, a black hole of rage." (L3989)

**F39. [III/35, L4029] Sidious: long precognitive meditation.**
> "After he had spent several hours drifting on the currents of possible futures" (L4029)

**F40. [III/35, L4109] Sidious: reading Vader's thoughts.**
> "As if I can't see the thought behind them!" (L4109)

**F41. [III/35, L4153] Sidious: knowing where the Jedi are going.** Possibly foresight, possibly Tarkin's tracking (L4391-4395).
> "They are traveling to Kashyyyk." (L4153)

### Part IV: Kashyyyk

**F42. [IV/39, L4621] Unnamed Wookiee: raw strength.** Throws a stormtrooper commander into a troop carrier and rips off his arm armor.
> "hurling him into the troop carrier with such force that the commander's forearm and elbow armor remained in the Wookiee's grip." (L4621)

**F43. [IV/39, L4629-4711] Starstone, Forte, Kulka, Klossi Anno, Jambe Lu, Nam Poorf (six Jedi), plus Tarfful, Chewbacca, and Wookiee warriors vs stormtrooper landing waves: group combat.** The first landing wave is wiped out.
> "Only the flashing blue blade of her lightsaber stood between her and certain death." (L4691)
> "The stormtroopers who had been the first to land were already dead, from blaster rounds, bowcaster quarrels, lightsaber slashes" (L4693)

**F44. [IV/40, L4765-4773] Vader vs Wookiee defenders on a Kachirho balcony: deflection under crossfire, mass melee kills.**
> "his ignited blade deflecting fire from all sides." (L4765)
> "Crimson blade slashing left and right, he parried blaster bolts and amputated limbs and heads." (L4771)
> "leaving more than a score of bodies in his wake." (L4773)

**F45. [IV/40, L4777] The six Jedi vs Commander Appo's stormtrooper cadre: deflection and melee.**
> "deflecting blaster bolts from the stormtroopers as they attacked, doing to Appo's cadre just what Vader had done to the Wookiees." (L4777)

**F46. [IV/41, L4795-4807] Vader vs Siadem Forte and Iwo Kulka (2-on-1, two Jedi Knights): lightsaber skill, precognition, speed.** They use two different styles, modeled on Obi-Wan and Anakin vs Dooku. Vader plays with them.
> "Vader was not only faster than Starstone remembered him being on Murkhana against Master Chatak, but also more agile." (L4803)
> "His style borrowed elements from all techniques of combat, even from the highest, most dangerous levels" (L4805)
> "his remarkable foresight allowed him to anticipate Forte's and Kulka's strategies and maneuvers" (L4805)
> "Toying with the Jedi, he grazed Forte on the left shoulder, then on the right thigh" (L4807)

**F47. [IV/41, L4809-4811] Vader vs Klossi Anno, then Forte and Kulka again, then Jambe Lu and Nam Poorf: quick kills one after another.** He slashes Anno across the back, beheads Forte and Kulka, cuts off Jambe's right arm and Nam's right leg.
> "Sidestepping, Vader slashed her across the back" (L4811)
> "neither of whom was an experienced fighter and both of whom Vader immediately eliminated from the fight" (L4811)

**F48. [IV/41, L4815-4833] Vader vs Olee Starstone (1-on-1): skill gap, mind reading, one-handed form.** He lets her wear herself out, reads her plan, and drives her to the balcony rim. She is wounded in the upper arm (L4875).
> "Vader was merely allowing her to vent, as the Temple's swordmaster had often done with students" (L4817)
> "Your thoughts give you away, Padawan," he said in a flash. (L4821)
> "She felt as if she were fighting a droid" (L4829)

**F49. [IV/41, L4835-4839] Shryne: telekinetic saber pull. Shryne kills Commander Appo.** The pull from the floor goes right past Vader's mask. Appo's severed head rolls to Vader's feet.
> "the blood-smeared hilt of Master Forte's lightsaber shot from the balcony floor, whizzing past Vader's masked face to snap into the hand of one of the figures and ignite." (L4837)

**F50. [IV/41, L4841] Archyr (smuggler): dual-blaster cover fire.**
> "blasters in both six-fingered hands, Archyr was dropping every stormtrooper who approached." (L4841)

**F51. [IV/42, L4869] Jambe Lu and Nam Poorf: using the Force to resist shock** after their amputations.
> "calling on the Force to keep from going into shock." (L4869)

**F52. [IV/43, L4987-4991] Vader vs Shryne, Kashyyyk duel, opening exchanges: power, spins, holding his stance.**
> "performed a lightning-fast underhand sweep that almost knocked Forte's lightsaber from Shryne's grip." (L4989)
> Shryne's slash "glanced off the back of his upraised left hand, smoke curling from the black glove." (L4989)
> Vader's spinning counter came "nearly cutting Shryne in half." (L4989)
> "Vader deflected the blows without altering his stance or giving ground" (L4991)

**F53. [IV/43, L4993-4997] Vader: aerial dodge. Shryne: lands a hit.** Shryne's low sweep is avoided with a flip. Shryne then cuts Vader's prosthetic right forearm.
> "Vader leapt high, half twisting in midair and coming down behind Shryne." (L4995)
> "Scrambling to his feet, Shryne hurled himself forward, catching Vader in the right forearm." (L4995)

**F54. [IV/43, L5031] Vader: pressing with an old, grounded style.**
> "Vader closed the distance between them in a heartbeat, slashing left and right with potent vertical strokes" (L5031)
> "It was an old style, the very opposite of what was said to have been Dooku's style, and Shryne had no defense against it." (L5031)

**F55. [IV/44, L5071, L5083] Starstone: sensing life and location.** From a ship in the air, she senses that Shryne and Vader are alive inside the tree.
> "They're inside! I can feel them." (L5083)

**F56. [IV/45, L5131] Wookiees (including the young): melee strength.**
> "tearing scores of troopers limb from limb before succumbing to blasterfire." (L5131)

**F57. [IV/46, L5141-5147] Shryne: third hit on Vader. Shryne pushes Vader onto the defensive.**
> "Shryne's slashing strike to Vader's lower left leg, owing as much to luck as to skill, released another shower of sparks." (L5141)
> "Shryne's determination to thrust his lightsaber into the control box Vader wore on his chest had forced the Sith to adopt a more defensive style that had left his limbs vulnerable." (L5147)

**F58. [IV/46, L5157-5175] Vader: large-scale telekinetic barrage, which ends the duel.** Vader puts his saber away and tears apart the wooden ramps, throwing planks, rails, pegs, and posts at Shryne from every direction. Shryne, who is guided by the Force, cannot keep up. He is hit in the thigh, shoulders, arms, forehead, and kidneys, and falls from the bridge.
> "Vader was using his dark side abilities to dismantle the ramps!" (L5165)
> "the floorboards were coming in larger and larger pieces, from all directions, and faster than he could parry them." (L5167)
> "Five meters away Vader stood, his hands crossed in front of him, lightsaber hanging on his belt." (L5169)

**F59. [IV/46, L5177, L5213] Shryne: durability against Vader's attack.** The fall breaks his left arm and shoulder and ruptures an organ. He dies minutes later (L5213, L5467-5469).
> "Give in the wooden floor saved his life, but at the expense of all the bones in his left arm and shoulder." (L5177)

**F60. [IV/46, L5179] Vader: controlled drop from the bridge.**
> "Vader jumped from the bridge, dropping to the floor with a grace he hadn't displayed before" (L5179)

**F61. [IV/47, L5299-5303] Starstone (lightsaber and blaster), Chewbacca (bowcaster), Archyr, and Wookiees vs battle droids aboard a Recusant-class destroyer.** They fight their way to the bridge and then turn the destroyer into a bomb against the Interdictor (L5325-5333, L5453).
> "Explosive quarrels from Chewbacca's bowcaster combined with blasterfire and deflections from Starstone's lightsaber dropped a dozen droids at a time." (L5303)

**F62. [IV/49, L5443] Vader: dark side power-up (an internal state, not a shown feat).**
> "He could feel the power of the dark side surging through him like an icy torrent. He felt invulnerable" (L5443)

**F63. [IV/49, L5453] Starstone's group: the Interdictor is destroyed** (the Recusant is used as a bomb, so not a Force feat). Hundreds of ships escape (L5471).

**F64. [IV/49, L5461-5467] Shryne: the precognition from F1 comes true.**
> "I've seen this," he uttered, mostly to himself. "I envisioned this... " (L5463)

### Epilogue

**F65. [Epi/50, L5539] Sidious: sensing Vader's inner change.**
> "He had sensed the change in him, even in the brief conversation they had had following the events on Kashyyyk." (L5539)

**F66. [Epi/54, L5857-5867] Qui-Gon Jinn (Force spirit): telepathic contact with Obi-Wan on Tatooine.**
> "It was a voice he hadn't heard in years, speaking to him not through his ears, but directly into his thoughts." (L5857)

## 2. Statements and hype (statements, not feats)

### Vader's suit limits and physical state
- **S1 [II/9, L903]** Vader cannot hold a kneel: "Without revealing his distress at being unable to maintain the kneeling posture" (L903)
- **S2 [II/10, L971]** Boots: "so heavy that he often felt rooted to the ground, or as if he were moving in high gravity." (L971)
- **S3 [II/10, L973]** "if he was going to have to call on the Force even to walk from place to place!" (L973)
- **S4 [II/10, L977]** Range of motion: "he could scarcely lift his arms over his head, and he had already been forced to adapt his lightsaber technique to compensate." (L977)
- **S5 [II/10, L979]** Prosthetic strength: "With the power of his arms alone, he had the ability to lift an adult being off the ground." He could also tune his forearms to crush his hilt. (L979)
- **S6 [II/10, L983-999]** Vision is limited by the red lenses (L983). Hearing is muffled and distorted (L987). He relies on a ventilator but "could breathe unassisted fir a limited time" (L993). Without the enunciator his voice is a whisper (L999).
- **S7 [II/10, L1011-1013]** "This was solitary confinement. Prison of the worst sort." / "Power without clear purpose.." (L1013)
- **S8 [II/13, L1315]** Chatak's cut "melted some of the artificial ligaments that allowed the hand to pronate." (L1315)
- **S9 [II/13, L1325]** He blames the med droids: "Slowed his reflexes, burdened him with armor and padding." (L1325)
- **S10 [II/13, L1365-1367]** His new hilt is "an inelegant weapon, verging on ungainly." / "Another cause of the injury to his left arm." (L1365-1367)
- **S11 [III/19, L2117]** Vader: "they wouldn't have if this suit didn't restrict me to the point of immobility!" (L2117)
- **S12 [III/21, L2347]** Sidious's view: "he would never be able to summon lightning or leap about like the Jedi had been fond of doing." (L2347). He leaps many times later (F34, F36, F53, F60), so this is Sidious's early read, not a hard limit.
- **S13 [III/21, L2355]** Sidious: "incapable of so much as breathing on his own, Vader could not rise to the challenge" (L2355)
- **S14 [III/35, L4133]** Sidious threatens: "Because you know that I could easily overwhelm the delicate electrical systems of your suit." (L4133)
- **S15 [IV/43, L5037; IV/46, L5147]** Shryne reads Vader's guard: "That was the reason for Vader's antique style-to protect his center, as Grievous had been forced to do." (L5037). Vader kept "elbows pressed tightly to his sides" (L5147).
- **S16 [IV/46, L5143]** Shryne: "he had to be more flesh-and-blood than cyborg, or he wouldn't have raged or been able to call on the Force with such intensity." (L5143)

### Vader on his own power vs Anakin's
- **S17 [II/10, L957]** "he felt uncertain about his ability to sustain that power. How far he might have been now had fate not intervened" (L957)
- **S18 [II/10, L961]** "Vader had lost everything, including-for the moment, at least-the self-confidence and unbridled skill he had demonstrated as Anakin Skywalker." (L961)
- **S19 [II/13, L1317-1319]** "Only Dooku, Asajj Ventress, and Obi-Wan had been good enough with a blade to injure him, so how had an undistinguished Jedi Knight been able to do so?" / "With the loss of my limbs, have I also lost strength in the Force?" (L1317-1319). Note that Vader calls Chatak a "Jedi Knight" here, while narration elsewhere calls her a Master (L1541, L4803).
- **S20 [II/13, L1321]** The doubt comes from Anakin's voice: "Anakin telling him that he was not as powerful as he thought he was." (L1321)
- **S21 [II/13, L1355-1357]** On the Force: "Leading him to believe that he had great power when he was little more than its servant." / "The power of the dark side would render the Force subservient" (L1355-1357)
- **S22 [II/16, L1787]** "despite the manifold losses he had endured, he remained the galaxy's best pilot." (L1787)
- **S23 [III/19, L2163]** Vader: "I wasn't strong enough to defeat Obi-Wan" (L2163)
- **S24 [III/24, L2695]** Precognition gone: "He no longer had visions, either. That ability, that double-edged ability, seemingly had been burned out of him on Mustafar." (L2695). Compare his "remarkable foresight" in a duel (L4805): combat foresight is still there.
- **S25 [III/24, L2747]** Grievance from his Jedi days: "if the High Council had seen fit to recognize his power, had granted him the status of Master" (L2747)
- **S26 [III/26, L3063]** "wishing he had the power to simply reach out and pluck the Jedi from the sky." (L3063)
- **S27 [III/31, L3603]** "his was not real power, but merely the execution of power. He wasn't the swordmaster so much as the weapon" (L3603)
- **S28 [IV/37, L4347]** Before Kashyyyk: "felt poised at the edge of a significant increase in his abilities." (L4347)
- **S29 [IV/49, L5443]** After Shryne: "crossed some invisible threshold to a new world." (L5443)
- **S30 [Epi/53, L5717]** "Anakin was gone" / "The Force as Anakin knew it was interred with him" (L5717)
- **S31 [Epi/53, L5723]** Sidious holds him back: "just enough to increase his apprentice's power, without making him supremely powerful." (L5723)

### Sidious on Vader, and statements about Sidious
- **S32 [II/9, L893]** "You are finally free to make full use of your powers." (L893)

### Sidious and Vader together
- **No on-page fight with both of them.** Sidious never fights in this book. His feats are perception, foresight, and healing (F25-F27, F31, F39-F41, F65).
- **Backstory they share:** Vader "helped Sidious defend himself against the Jedi who had sought his arrest" (L897), and Vader remembers Sidious's lightning throwing Windu (L2699).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch9, Part III, Ch24
- **Who is stronger:** Sidious says no one is stronger than Vader even crippled (L2161) and calls them "unconquerable" together. He also openly threatens to short out Vader's suit with lightning (L4133), and Vader says he needs Sidious "for a time" (L4143-4147). Sidious tells Vader Yoda would have done worse to him than Obi-Wan did (L2165). Sidious did not foresee Mustafar (L2313). Sidious plans to master power over death so he will never need to fear Vader (L5549).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch19, Part III, Ch35, Part III, Ch21, Part IV, Ch50
- **Debate takeaway:** Early-Empire Vader is clearly below Sidious (both say so, plus the suit weakness). Sidious ranks Vader above Dooku at full potential (L2157) and below Obi-Wan's Mustafar result for now (L2163-2165).

### Overall Vader progression in this book
1. **Murkhana (about 4 weeks after ROTS):** clumsy, vertical strikes, no style of his own, still loses only to a cut on his prosthetic (F14, S4, S10, S18).
2. **Alderaan:** more mobile, with repeated leaps, bare-hand deflection, and a long guided saber throw that overpowers a Jedi's TK (F34-F37).
3. **Kashyyyk (weeks of rage training later, L4347):** faster and more agile than at Murkhana (L4803), uses many forms and foresight, toys with two Knights, and finishes Shryne with a large telekinetic barrage (F46-F58). After that he "crossed some invisible threshold" (L5443), and Sidious senses it (L5539).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch37, Part IV, Ch41, Part IV, Ch49, Part IV, Ch50

## 4. Plot points that matter for these fights
- **Murkhana, last hours of the Clone Wars (Ch. 1-8):** Shryne, Bol Chatak, and Padawan Starstone destroy a shield generator. Order 66 comes. Commando Climber's Ion Team refuses to carry it out and lets the three Jedi go. Master Loorne and two Knights are killed elsewhere. The Jedi get the recall beacon message and then the "go into hiding" message (L859). They throw away their sabers (Chatak secretly keeps hers) and are captured disguised as mercenaries.
- **Vader's debut (Ch. 9-13):** About four weeks after ROTS, Sidious sends Vader to punish the clones who disobeyed. Vader kills Ion Team commandos. Chatak reveals herself and dies against him. Vader's suit has many flaws and his confidence is low. Shryne and Starstone escape with a mind trick.
- **Escape (Ch. 14-16):** Crime boss Cash Garrulan helps them. Vader uses TK on Garrulan but is fooled by a decoy. The Jedi get away in Brudi Gayn's CloakShape on a booster ring. Garrulan is killed later (L3161).
- **Smugglers and survivors (Ch. 18-27):** Shryne meets his mother, Captain Jula, on the *Drunk Dancer*. Starstone's 913 signal brings in six Jedi refugees (Forte, Kulka, Anno, Nalual, Jambe Lu, Nam Poorf). They break into the Temple beacon from Jaguada's moon. Vader watches from the Temple and sends troops, who get trapped by reactivated droids.
- **Sidious and Vader (Ch. 19, 21, 28, 35):** Sidious handles Vader's self-pity. Vader is told he lost to Obi-Wan because Obi-Wan meant to kill him. Sidious sends him to Alderaan "to sharpen" his hunger for Jedi. After that, Vader admits he needs Sidious for now.
- **Alderaan (Ch. 29-35):** Shryne now works for the smugglers and is getting ex-Senator Fang Zar off the planet. Vader is there to take Zar back to Coruscant. Bail realizes Vader is Anakin and hides Leia and the droids. Shryne baits Vader with a blaster. Vader's thrown saber kills Zar and badly wounds Jula.
- **Kashyyyk (Ch. 36-49):** Tarkin lets the Jedi through the checkpoint so the Empire has an excuse to invade and enslave Wookiees as labor for the battle station (L4423, L5501). The Jedi fight beside Tarfful and Chewbacca. Vader lands, kills more than 20 Wookiees, beheads Forte and Kulka, and maims Anno, Lu, and Poorf. He toys with Starstone until Shryne arrives. Shryne sends the others away and duels Vader alone. Vader wins with TK, reveals that "Lord Sidious is the Emperor" (L5201) and that he is Anakin Skywalker, "the twenty-first" (L5225), and Shryne dies as his vision comes true. Starstone's group uses a Separatist destroyer as a bomb on the Interdictor, and hundreds of ships escape. Kashyyyk falls.
- **Epilogue (Ch. 50-54):** Wookiees are sent to the battle station. Sidious senses that Vader has changed and starts his real apprenticeship. HoloNet presents Vader to the galaxy. The surviving Jedi split up and give up their lightsabers. Obi-Wan learns that Vader is alive, and Qui-Gon tells him Vader will never come to Tatooine.

## Story and prose notes

*Added after a second full read of the source file (all 5,876 lines, in order, in chunks). `L####` is the line number in that file. Text inside guillemets is copied exactly from the file, including its OCR quirks (for example "Star-stone", "Lambe", "Derail", "Tian Cluster", "0n" with a zero at L5125) and its use of a plain hyphen for dashes. A script checked every guillemet quote against the line it cites, and each quote was also confirmed with `grep -F` against a UTF-8 copy of the file. Anything not taken from the novel is labeled as outside context.*

### SP1. Plot summary, in order

The POV threads are: **Roan Shryne** (and later his mother **Jula**), **Olee Starstone**, **Darth Vader**, **Darth Sidious/Palpatine**, **Bail Organa**, the clone commando **Climber** and **Commander Salvo** (Part I), the crime boss **Cash Garrulan**, **Chewbacca** (one section), the Interdictor captain **Ugan** (one section), and **Obi-Wan Kenobi** (last chapter).

**Part I: The Outer Rim Sieges (L15–L878), Murkhana, the last hours of the Clone Wars**

- **Ch1 (L19).** *Shryne:* Jedi Knight Roan Shryne rides a gunship down through Murkhana's man-made clouds and remembers his late Master Nat-Sem's lessons about seeing past the white (L23–L39). He has a vision of a green forest world, ships, and «a lone figure stretched out his hand, tearing aside a curtain black as night...» (L47). He banters with clone Commander Salvo of the Thirty-second air combat wing. Salvo wants an orbital bombardment; Shryne defends Palpatine's hearts-and-minds policy (L79).
- **Ch2 (L101).** *Shryne:* Murkhana is the Corporate Alliance's headquarters and home of Passel Argente (L105). Shryne drops with Master Bol Chatak (an Iridonian Zabrak) and her Padawan Olee Starstone (L111–L123). He mentions that «Until recently, Shryne, too, had had a Padawan learner...» (L125). Commando Climber's Ion Team brings in a captured mercenary, Idis of the Vibroblade Brigade, who gives up the location of the landing-platform shield generator inside a medcenter (L195–L199). Shryne vetoes bombing the medcenter (L207–L213).
- **Ch3 (L245).** *Shryne:* Shryne, Climber, and a spec-three take the generator room. Shryne kicks his dropped lightsaber into Climber's hand to save him (L327) and notes that his Force strength is fading: «with the death of every Jedi, the war was leaching some of the Force out the universe» (L331).
- **Ch4 (L365).** *Climber:* Salvo radios a new priority: «The Jedi are to be killed.» (L403). Climber decides to obey on the surface only (L445).
- **Ch5 (L447).** *Shryne:* The three Jedi joke on the way to the rally point. Shryne and Chatak sense a trap (L503–L521). Ion Team blinds Salvo's platoon with electrostatic detonators and lets the Jedi go: «We received orders to kill you.» (L545), «We don't kill our own.» (L575).
- **Ch6 (L597).** *Climber / Shryne:* Salvo tells Climber the order came from the Chancellor (L613–L629). The Jedi flee. Shryne finds that Master Loorne and the other Jedi are dead (L679), and the three disguise themselves as mercenaries (L715).
- **Ch7 (L717).** *Climber:* Salvo passes on the official story that four Jedi Masters tried to assassinate Palpatine and that the Jedi engineered the war (L729).
- **Ch8 (L763).** *Shryne:* A coded burst from the Temple recalls all Jedi to Coruscant (L785). The three leap across broken bridge pylons to the landing platform (L821–L833). A second burst orders the opposite: «All Jedi are ordered to avoid Coruscant at all costs. We're to abandon whatever missions we're involved in, and go into hiding.» (L859). Every droid shuts down (L869), clones surround them, and Shryne drops his lightsaber, comlink, and beacon into the sea (L877).

**Part II: The Emperor's Emissary (L879–L1824)**

- **Ch9 (L883).** *Vader:* Four weeks after the war (L889), Vader kneels before Palpatine's hologram on the new Imperator-class *Exactor*. He is ordered to punish the clones on Murkhana who refused Order 66, because of «Contagion» (L927). Palpatine adds that Vader may kill any escaped Jedi he finds (L943).
- **Ch10 (L945).** *Vader:* Vader catalogs every flaw of the suit ("this is not walking / seeing / hearing / breathing / living", L965–L1011) and decides he is «merely a minion, an errand boy» (L955). He leaves with Commander Appo of the 501st (L1019).
- **Ch11 (L1029).** *Shryne:* After four weeks in a prison warehouse, Shryne sees Vader land. Vader kills two Ion Team commandos, and Climber and the third are captured (L1141–L1199). Chatak reveals herself («But I am!», L1151), duels Vader, wounds his forearm (sparks come out, L1173), and is beheaded (L1185). Vader eyes Starstone, and the prisoners are sent toward Agon Nine (L1201).
- **Ch12 (L1203).** *Shryne:* Shryne tells grieving Starstone that her Master acted in vengeance (L1215–L1223). Starstone, trained in Sith history under Jocasta Nu (L1277), insists that Vader is a Sith. Shryne uses a mind trick on the boarding troopers, and the two of them escape (L1297–L1311).
- **Ch13 (L1313).** *Vader:* Vader repairs his arm and argues with the "specter of Anakin" (L1321). He wonders whether Sidious built the suit as a prison, blames Padme and Obi-Wan, curses the Force (L1355), and studies his new lightsaber, which mimics Anakin's but fits his large hands badly (L1359–L1365). Appo reports two missing prisoners. Vader: «I will handle it myself.» (L1381)
- **Ch14 (L1383).** *Starstone / Shryne:* They go to Cash Garrulan, a Twi'lek and former Black Sun vigo who was Shryne's informant (L1397). Garrulan tells them the Jedi are blamed for the whole war and almost all are dead (L1483–L1487). Shryne realizes «The order was finished.» (L1493)
- **Ch15 (L1539).** *Vader / Garrulan:* Vader reads Temple records on Starstone and Shryne (L1541–L1565). Vader confronts Garrulan, lifting him with the Force (L1601). Garrulan points him at a decoy ship, the *Dead Ringer* (L1661).
- **Ch16 (L1675).** *Vader / Shryne:* The decoy is exposed (L1709). Vader orders Garrulan's ship destroyed with everyone aboard (L1733) and chases the real escape craft, Brudi Gayn's CloakShape, in a black Jedi interceptor (L1783–L1787). The CloakShape slips into a hyperdrive booster ring (L1815). Vader: «If the Jedi are so determined to disappear, then let them.» (L1823)

**Part III: Imperial Center (L1825–L4158)**

- **Ch17 (L1829).** *Bail:* The Emperor tells a group of Senators that his decrees will now be final and «The Republic is extinct.» (L1839). Afterward Mon Mothma talks resistance. Bail urges patience because he is protecting Leia: he knows the twins survived (L1901). Bail sees Vader on a landing platform and nearly collapses: «You're right. Some Jedi did survive.» (L1949)
- **Ch18 (L1951).** *Shryne:* Gayn brings them to the smuggler freighter *Drunk Dancer* and its crew (L1953–L1971). Starstone proposes broadcasting a 913 code through the ship's comm suite (L2003). Shryne falsely promises Jedi funds to pay for it (L2059). The captain arrives: «I gave birth to you. I'm your mother, Jedi.» (L2075)
- **Ch19 (L2077).** *Sidious / Vader:* In the medical lab atop Palpatine's building, Vader throws a med droid (L2099), blames his equipment, and accuses Sidious over Padme (L2143). Sidious answers that Padme died of Vader's anger (L2145), that «power is joy» (L2153), and that Obi-Wan won on Mustafar because he came to kill (L2165).
- **Ch20 (L2171).** *Shryne:* Jula explains that Shryne's father Jen gave him to the Temple and that she sensed him through the Force (L2207–L2227). She urges him to live a real life (L2249). Starstone's signal gets an answer from a group of Jedi (L2265). Starstone scorns the "Lost Twenty" who left the Order (L2289–L2293). Jula warns Shryne off Force persuasion (L2305).
- **Ch21 (L2307).** *Sidious:* Sidious recalls saving Anakin and dreams of unlocking the Sith secret of cheating death (L2323–L2325). He reflects on why he sent Anakin to the Temple (L2337) and on the Rule of Two (L2339), and he resolves to shake Vader out of his despair even at his own peril (L2355–L2357). Mas Amedda reports the Jedi signal, and Sidious keeps Vader on Coruscant (L2369).
- **Ch22 (L2371).** *Shryne:* At the rendezvous, ARC-170s and a Republic light cruiser jump the Jedi transport. The *Drunk Dancer* fights them off with Shryne directing fire, which troubles him because it means killing clones (L2467), and recovers the transport before jumping away (L2571).
- **Ch23 (L2573).** *Shryne:* Six battered Jedi come aboard: Siadem Forte, Deran Nalual, Klossi Anno, Iwo Kulka, Jambe Lu, and Nam Poorf (L2581). They talk about the dead Council members (L2597) and the Chosen One prophecy (L2607). Starstone wants to keep gathering survivors. Jula forbids further broadcasts from her ship (L2661). Filli Bitters knows where to find a hyperwave transceiver powerful enough to reach the Temple data banks (L2673).
- **Ch24 (L2675).** *Vader:* Sidious sends Vader to the empty Temple, officially to fetch Sith holocrons (L2679). Vader relives the massacre, insists to himself that he did it for Padme and had planned to kill Sidious with her (L2719–L2731), and his anguished moan topples the archive busts (L2759). Armand Isard reports that someone is remotely accessing the beacon (L2767).
- **Ch25 (L2769).** *Shryne:* On Jaguada's moon, in an ancient complex Starstone links to the Sith (L2779), Shryne broods about leaving. Jula reveals that her crew once delivered comm hardware there for "Tyranus" (L2855). Starstone has the slicers boost power to the transceiver, and the whole facility, droids included, comes back on (L2885–L2899).
- **Ch26 (L2901).** *Vader / Shryne:* Vader traces the access to Bol Chatak's transceiver (L2911) and sends the Jaguada garrison. The Jedi cut the link, escape, and leave the troopers sealed in with reactivated droids (L3043). Vader: «Sidious was wrong, he told himself as he hurried through the empty hallways.» (L3067)
- **Ch27 (L3071).** *Shryne:* With data on hundreds of Jedi (L3079), Starstone plans a search. Shryne refuses to lead it and says they will part at Mossak (L3115). Jula asks him to join her crew and offers a "good deed" contract: smuggling a former Senator home. She also tells him «Cash is dead.» (L3161)
- **Ch28 (L3163).** *Sidious:* The holocrons Vader brought back are forgeries (L3167). Mas Amedda reports that Fang Zar plans to slip off Alderaan through a Murkhana crime contact. Sidious sends Vader, «To sharpen» his hunger for the Jedi (L3247).
- **Ch29 (L3249).** *Bail:* Refugees march in Aldera (L3259–L3275). Bail and Captain Antilles wonder whether Vader is Anakin (L3293). The *Exactor* arrives, and Sate Pestage announces Darth Vader (L3359). Bail orders Breha, Leia, and the droids hidden (L3377–L3385).
- **Ch30 (L3387).** *Shryne:* Shryne, Skeck, and Archyr try to collect "our bundle", Fang Zar (L3443), but the crowd turns rowdy at the south gate (L3465).
- **Ch31 (L3483).** *C-3PO and R2-D2 / Vader:* The smugglers force the droids to let them into the palace (L3515–L3549). Vader meets Bail, and they spar over protests and freedom (L3589–L3647). Breha appears on a holo with the baby, and Vader asks to meet the Queen (L3663).
- **Ch32 (L3665).** *Shryne / Bail:* R2-D2 leads the intruders in circles and then straight into Breha and Leia, setting off alarms (L3731–L3737). Bail decides «This is Leia's father» (L3745). Security footage shows Shryne, and Vader concludes the Jedi have come for Zar (L3789). Breha cancels her visit, which saves Leia from meeting Vader (L3793).
- **Ch33 (L3809).** *Shryne / Vader:* Shryne shows himself to Vader as bait while Skeck and Archyr move Zar (L3881). Vader turns blaster bolts with his bare hand (L3907).
- **Ch34 (L3917).** *Bail / Shryne:* Pestage forces Bail to seal the palace (L3957). Vader hurls his lightsaber over the closing gate. It boomerangs, kills Fang Zar, and cuts Jula across the back (L3985).
- **Ch35 (L3995).** *Sidious / Shryne / Vader:* Sidious hears his advisers' reports (L4003–L4019) and is pleased that Vader is «Even more troubled by the outcome.» (L4047). Zar dies and Jula survives (L4053). Shryne concludes that Vader is a Sith serving Palpatine (L4073) and that the Force as the Jedi knew it has been defeated (L4085). Sidious goads Vader to admit that he needs his Master «For a time» (L4147), then points him at the Jedi bound for Kashyyyk (L4153).

**Part IV: Kashyyyk (L4159–L5474)**

- **Ch36 (L4163).** *Starstone:* Starstone now leads the seven survivors (L4199). Their search has found only dead Jedi (L4207). They fly to Kashyyyk hoping Yoda survived there (L4217–L4219). The middleman Cudgel meets them, and Wookiees draw weapons (L4331).
- **Ch37 (L4333).** *Vader:* Aboard the *Executrix*, Moff Wilhuff Tarkin reveals that he let the Jedi transport through on purpose, and proposes using the hunt to get skilled labor for the Emperor's battle station (L4391–L4433).
- **Ch38 (L4435).** *Starstone:* Starstone admits «We're Jedi» (L4447). Tarfful and Chewbacca tell her Vos and Unduli died and that Yoda escaped in a pod (L4517–L4523), and they offer sanctuary (L4559–L4565). An Imperial troop carrier lands (L4569).
- **Ch39 (L4573).** *Cudgel / Vader / Starstone:* A stormtrooper commander provokes the Wookiees and the fighting starts. The Jedi ignite their lightsabers (L4633). Vader orders the Wookiees taken alive and Interdictors deployed (L4649–L4669). Starstone sees Vader's shuttle and decides: «Then it's up to us to make this about Vader» (L4727).
- **Ch40 (L4729).** *Chewbacca / Vader:* Chewbacca leads an evacuation and reflects that the war was «a struggle between two evils» (L4739). Vader allows orbital bombardment but «save Kachirho for last» (L4761). He cuts through the Wookiees on a balcony and faces the Jedi (L4771–L4791).
- **Ch41 (L4793).** *Starstone:* Vader kills Forte and Kulka and maims Klossi Anno, Jambe Lu, and Nam Poorf (L4811). He toys with Starstone (L4817–L4833). Shryne arrives on the drop ship with Archyr, pulls Forte's lightsaber to his hand with the Force, beheads Appo (L4837–L4839), and offers himself: «Me for them.» (L4851)
- **Ch42 (L4867).** *Starstone:* The wounded are flown down. Orbital barrage sets the forest ablaze (L4925). Chewbacca agrees to pilot the transport (L4949–L4955).
- **Ch43 (L4973).** *Shryne / Vader:* Shryne and Vader duel. Shryne's hits draw sparks (L4997–L4999). Turbolaser fire destroys the balcony and Vader's shuttle (L5001). Shryne decides the chest control panel is the target (L5037).
- **Ch44 (L5039).** *Starstone:* Starstone senses Shryne still alive inside the tree (L5083) but leaves on Cudgel's prompting. The Interdictor traps the fleeing ships (L5109–L5115). Filli has an idea (L5121).
- **Ch45 (L5123).** Omniscient: «Kashyyyk had fallen.» (L5137)
- **Ch46 (L5139).** *Shryne:* Vader rips the wooden ramps apart with the Force and pelts Shryne until he falls, mortally hurt (L5159–L5177). Vader reveals «Lord Sidious is the Emperor.» (L5201) and that he is Anakin Skywalker, «the twenty-first» (L5225).
- **Ch47 (L5227).** *Starstone:* The group takes over a derelict Recusant-class destroyer whose droid brain is trying to turn the ship into a bomb, and they aim it at the Interdictor (L5325–L5335).
- **Ch48 (L5339).** *Jula / Ugan:* Jula takes in the wounded and grieves for Roan (L5397). On the Interdictor, Ensign Nullip warns Captain Ugan too late (L5433).
- **Ch49 (L5435).** *Vader:* Vader feels he has crossed a threshold into the dark side (L5443). The Interdictor explodes, hundreds of ships escape, and the dying Shryne recognizes the vision he had at the start (L5467). Vader orders the bombardment to continue (L5473).

**Epilogue (L5475–L5876)**

- **Epigraph (L5477–L5481).** Darth Bane's Rule of Two.
- **Ch50 (L5483).** *Sidious:* Tarkin reports 200,000 Wookiees held in camps (L5495). The Emperor approves shipping «the slaves to the weapon» (L5501), lets rumors about Vader spread (L5527), and senses that Vader's true apprenticeship can begin (L5539).
- **Ch51 (L5567).** *Bail:* Mon Mothma holds Leia and presses for rebellion (L5631–L5635). HoloNet reveals Lord Vader after the Kashyyyk "police action" (L5643–L5653). Bail: «All the more reason to keep hope hidden» (L5661).
- **Ch52 (L5663).** *Starstone:* The five surviving Jedi break up. Starstone, Chewbacca, and Cudgel stay with the *Drunk Dancer* to find the Wookiee captives and smuggle Jedi to safety (L5681–L5685). The others plan to infiltrate Imperial academies and projects (L5691–L5693). They lay down their lightsabers (L5699).
- **Ch53 (L5703).** *Vader:* The bridge crew salute Vader. He looks forward to taking an apprentice and toppling Sidious (L5727).
- **Ch54 (L5731).** *Obi-Wan:* In Anchorhead on Tatooine, Obi-Wan watches over Luke, hears that Vader is alive (L5811), and is reassured by Qui-Gon's voice that Vader will never come to Tatooine (L5867).

### SP2. Character profiles

- **Darth Vader (Anakin Skywalker).**
  - *Background:* About four weeks after Mustafar, he is cut off from his old life and lives inside a badly made suit (L889, L967–L1011). Sidious's med droids rebuilt him, and he wrecked them with a scream when he learned of Padme's death (L2087).
  - *Motivation:* power, plus escape from Anakin's memory. He tells himself «Anakin is dead» (L953), but Anakin lingers «like pain from a phantom limb» (L915).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch10, Part II, Ch9
  - *Arc:* At first he is clumsy («Vader, by contrast, was clumsy», L1169), self-pitying («Look at us. Are these the faces of victory?», L2133), and easily fooled (Garrulan, Jaguada). He finds power by embracing rage (L4347). By Kashyyyk he is «faster than Starstone remembered him being on Murkhana against Master Chatak, but also more agile» (L4803). After killing Shryne he feels his suit is «little more than an outfit» (L5443).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch11, Part III, Ch19, Part IV, Ch37, Part IV, Ch41, Part IV, Ch49
  - *Relationships:* Sidious (below). He claims Padme and Obi-Wan sentenced him to the suit (L1335). He resents Bail and suspects him of helping Yoda (L3563–L3565). He feels more at home with clone troopers than with other people (L1023), and with Appo especially («I was rather fond of Commander Appo», L4975).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch13, Part III, Ch31, Part II, Ch10, Part IV, Ch43
  - *Fate:* unveiled to the galaxy (L5565, L5651). He dreams of his own apprentice and of overthrowing Sidious (L5727).
- **Vader's inner struggle with Anakin's memory.**
  - The "specter of Anakin" asks whether he has lost strength in the Force (L1319–L1321) and whether Sidious engineered his prison (L1327).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch13
  - He splits himself in two: «Anakin Skywalker had died on Coruscant.» (L1345) / «But the Chosen One had died on Mustafar.» (L1347).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch13
  - In the Temple he relives Anakin's acts, and the memory «curdled his blood» (L2715).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch24
  - On Alderaan he reasons «it was Skywalker, not Vader, who had lived on Tatooine» (L3577), yet grieves that he can never go to Naboo or Tatooine (L2759).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch31, Part III, Ch24
  - By Ch53: «Anakin was gone; a memory so deeply buried he might have dreamed rather than lived it.» (L5717).
  - Qui-Gon's verdict: «the Anakin you and I knew is imprisoned by the dark side» (L5861).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch54
- **Darth Sidious / Emperor Palpatine.**
  - *Background:* He is publicly scarred by the "four treasonous Jedi Masters" and by Yoda (L891). He was trained by Plagueis, whom he killed in his sleep (L5545).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch9, Part IV, Ch50
  - *Motivation:* absolute rule, and the secret of life over death (L2323, L5549).
  - *Relationship with Vader:* Sidious deliberately manipulates him («Powered by treachery», L2349). He sends Vader on missions meant to sharpen his hunger (the Temple, Alderaan) and goads him to admit «I need you» (L4143). He knows «Fundamental to Vader's growth was the desire to overthrow his Master.» (L2353) and keeps open the option of a replacement apprentice or weapon (L5559–L5561).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch21, Part III, Ch35, Part IV, Ch50
  - *Fate:* consolidating power, with the battle station under construction (L5535).
- **Roan Shryne.**
  - *Background:* He was found on Weytta after an unexplained "incident" (L1551) and refused service in the Acquisition Division (L1553). He studied weapons and crime syndicates and ran Garrulan as an informant (L1555–L1557). He was a peripheral member of the "Old Guard" (L1559). He lost his Master Nat-Sem and his first Padawan at Geonosis, and a second learner at Manari (L1561–L1563).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch15
  - *Character:* pessimistic, sardonic, losing touch with the Force (L41, L331).
  - *Arc:* He survives Order 66, then decides the Order is finished (L1493) and tells Starstone to hide (L3095). He drifts into Jula's crew; Alderaan is «the first day of the rest of his life» (L3419). Watching Vader's thrown lightsaber, he concludes the Force itself has been defeated (L4085). He returns to save the Jedi on Kashyyyk: «He is a Jedi again.» (L4865).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch14, Part III, Ch27, Part III, Ch30, Part III, Ch35, Part IV, Ch41
  - *Fate:* killed by Vader inside the Kachirho tree. He dies after learning the truth and seeing his vision fulfilled: «the Force will never die» (L5467).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch49
- **Olee Starstone.**
  - *Background:* A former archivist apprentice of Jocasta Nu (L1543). Bol Chatak found her on Eriadu and took her as Padawan in the war's second year (L1543–L1545). She is «smart as a vibro-whip» (L1547), chews her lip, and keeps offering theories (L797–L801).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch15, Part I, Ch8
  - *Arc:* She goes from eager Padawan, to grieving (L1205–L1223), to the crusader who reunites survivors, against Shryne's advice. She gets the Jaguada facility reactivated and becomes the group's reluctant leader (L4199). She blames herself for Kashyyyk («She should have listened to Shryne», L4699) and comes to accept that «there are no more Jedi» (L5675).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch12, Part IV, Ch36, Part IV, Ch39, Part IV, Ch52
  - *Relationships:* Chatak (her Master); Shryne (sparring mentor, then surrogate Master: «you're the only Master we have», L3111); Filli Bitters (a growing affection she tells herself she resists, L4193); Jula (she embraces her at the end, L5353).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch27, Part IV, Ch36, Part IV, Ch48
  - *Fate:* stays aboard the *Drunk Dancer* to help Wookiees and smuggle Jedi to safety (L5681–L5685).
- **Shryne and Starstone.** Their dynamic begins as teasing between a gruff Knight and someone else's Padawan (L113–L119, L469–L499). After Chatak's death Shryne becomes her protector and critic. They split over strategy (L3093–L3121), but he admits «I've already lost two Padawans to this rotten war, and I don't want to lose you to it.» (L3105). His sacrifice on Kashyyyk saves her. Vader taunts him for «Treating her like your personal learner» (L4849).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part I, Ch2, Part I, Ch5, Part III, Ch27, Part IV, Ch41
- **Jula (Shryne's mother), captain of the *Drunk Dancer*.**
  - *Background:* Force-sensitive. Her own parents hid her from the Jedi (L2219–L2221). Her husband Jen gave baby Roan to the Temple, which ended their marriage (L2225–L2227). She took up piloting partly hoping to find him (L2221).
  - *Arc:* She tries to pull Shryne into "real life" and argues that letting go of the Order honors it (L3133–L3137). Vader's lightsaber wounds her on Alderaan (L3985).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch27, Part III, Ch34
  - *Shryne/Jula:* He feels for her only «an unspecific connection in the Force» (L2201) and calls her «A victim of attachment» (L2237), yet he joins her crew. She ends with «I love you, Roan.» (L5397) and «We're going to keep my son's memory alive» (L5687).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch20, Part IV, Ch48, Part IV, Ch52
- **Bol Chatak.** Iridonian Zabrak Master, patient and tolerant (L123). She secretly keeps her lightsaber in captivity, challenges Vader to save the commandos, wounds him, and is beheaded (L1151–L1185). Her beacon transceiver drives the plot (L1243, L2911).
- **Climber and Ion Team; Commander Salvo.** Climber's loyalty to the soldiers who fight beside him beats his programming (L631). He spares the Jedi, and Vader executes his team (L1141). Salvo obeys absolutely («Palpatine is the Republic, Climber.», L625) and expects promotion now that the Jedi are gone (L753).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part I, Ch6, Part II, Ch11, Part I, Ch7
- **Commander Appo.** He led the 501st against the Temple (L1019) and serves as Vader's right hand. Shryne kills him (L4839).
- **Cash Garrulan.** Twi'lek former Black Sun vigo and Shryne's old informant (L1397). He fools Vader with a decoy (L1661). Vader orders his ship destroyed (L1733), and he is later reported dead (L3161).
- ***Drunk Dancer* crew.** Brudi Gayn, a casual but expert pilot (L1735–L1737); first mate Skeck Draggle and security chief Archyr Beil, six-fingered humanoids (L1969); slicer Filli Bitters, who is drawn to Starstone (L2179); comms specialist Eyl Dix, with antennae (L1971).
- **The Jedi refugees.** Siadem Forte, a burned Knight, and his blinded Togruta Padawan Deran Nalual; Klossi Anno, a Chalactan Padawan; Iwo Kulka, a Ho'Din Knight; Jambe Lu and Nam Poorf of the Agricultural Corps (L2581). Forte and Kulka die on Kashyyyk (L4811). The other four survive, three of them maimed by Vader, and scatter to sabotage the Empire from inside (L5691–L5693).
- **Bail Organa, and Bail and the Jedi survivors.**
  - *Role:* He knows Palpatine is a Sith and that the twins live. He fears for Leia, whom he is raising with Breha (L1897–L1905). He was first at the Temple after the massacre and rescued Yoda (L1913). «were it not for genetics, he might have been a Jedi» (L3257).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch17, Part III, Ch29
  - *Choices:* To protect Leia he lies low and refuses Mon Mothma's push for early rebellion (L1933, L3287–L3289). He recognizes Vader as Anakin (L3745, L3807). Pestage and Palpatine conclude afterward that Bail was willing to let Zar escape (L4031–L4033).
  - *Closing line:* «All the more reason to keep hope hidden» (L5661), thinking of Yoda, Obi-Wan, and Luke (L5659).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch51
- **Others at court and in the Senate.** Mon Mothma (pushes for resistance, L1931, L5631). Fang Zar (Loyalist Senator of Sern Prime, killed by Vader's thrown lightsaber, L3985, L4053). Sate Pestage (Bail's "archnemesis", L3335). Mas Amedda (Chagrian, L3177). Armand Isard (ISB chief, L2765). Captain Raymus Antilles and the droids, with C-3PO's memory wiped (L3291).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch17, Part IV, Ch51, Part III, Ch34, Part III, Ch35, Part III, Ch29, Part III, Ch28, Part III, Ch24
- **Wilhuff Tarkin.** A newly titled Moff (L4375) who sets up the Kashyyyk invasion to get slave labor for the battle station (L4423, L5501–L5535). He offers Vader a "partnership" (L4433).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch37, Part IV, Ch50
- **Chewbacca, Tarfful, and Cudgel.** War chief Tarfful and Chewbacca took part in Yoda's escape (L4507, L4523). Chewbacca's family home of Rwookrrorro burns (L5101). He leaves with the *Drunk Dancer* to fight for his people from outside (L5381). Cudgel is a hairy human trade liaison (L4271).
- **Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn.** As "Ben" on Tatooine, Obi-Wan watches Luke (L5751, L5767). He is shaken to learn that Vader lives and doubts his choice on Mustafar (L5765, L5845–L5849). Qui-Gon's voice reassures him (L5857–L5871).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch54

### SP3. Themes: what the book is about

- **Vader's self-loathing and the suit.**
  - The suit is first a prison: «This was solitary confinement. Prison of the worst sort. Continual torture.» (L1013).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch10
  - It is also a mirror of his guilt: «I brought about the very thing I feared for her. I'm to blame.» (L2147).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch19
  - By the end the suit is a costume and then an outfit (L3561, L5443). The book tracks the shift from physical complaint («This is not living», L1011) to psychological victory over Anakin.
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch31, Part IV, Ch49, Part II, Ch10
  - Sidious reads it the same way: «Vader's real weaknesses were psychological rather than physical» (L2347).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch21
- **Order 66 survivors: hide or band together.**
  - The beacon's last word was to hide (L859, L3095). Starstone's instinct is to gather and rebuild (L2621).
  - Gathering brings disaster: Jaguada, then Kashyyyk, where the Jedi become the Empire's pretext (L4695).
  - The survivors' end state is dispersal and infiltration (L5675–L5697). Obi-Wan's verdict mirrors Shryne's: they should have gone to ground (L5785).
- **The Jedi were played.** Characters repeat the idea: Eyl Dix at L2027, Shryne at L2195, Obi-Wan at L5789–L5793. The Order's privilege blinded it: «And that was why we didn't see it coming» (L2191).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch18, Part III, Ch20, Part IV, Ch54
- **Attachment and love.** Starstone recites the doctrine «Love leads to attachment; attachment to greed.» (L2297), and Jula answers «Olee, love is about all we have left.» (L2301). Vader's attachment to Padme drove his fall (L2331–L2337). By the end Starstone admits she has «lost the skill» of avoiding attachment (L5359).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch20, Part III, Ch21, Part IV, Ch48
- **Clones and independent thought.** Palpatine diagnoses «Contagion» (L927). Climber chooses comrades over orders (L631). Salvo warns him: «You shouldn't be thinking for yourself, brother. It's more dangerous than you know.» (L637).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch9, Part I, Ch6
- **Sith power and treachery.** Power through understanding versus understanding through power (L909). The dark side flows from «appetite, rivalry, avarice, and malice» (L4341). The Master–apprentice bond runs on betrayal (L2349, L4145–L4147, L5727).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch9, Part IV, Ch37, Part III, Ch21, Part III, Ch35, Part IV, Ch53
- **The Empire's legitimacy built on fear.** Vader states the aim directly («I am something to be feared.», L4647). The Emperor wants Vader seen so that others ask how powerful the Emperor must be (L4027). The Kashyyyk spin follows (L5643).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch39, Part III, Ch35, Part IV, Ch51
- **The Force endures.** Shryne's closing realization: «the Force will never die» (L5467). Bail's «keep hope hidden» (L5661) and the Luke thread on Tatooine point forward.
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch49, Part IV, Ch51

### SP4. Notable prose passages and dialogue

**Narration: power, menace, atmosphere, inner thought** (all verbatim):

1. Shryne's vision: «Shryne knew he had stepped out of time, into some truth beyond reckoning.» (L49)

### SP5. Worldbuilding and lore stated in the text

- **Places.**
  - *Murkhana:* Koorivar world and Corporate Alliance headquarters, with weather-machine clouds, anti-laser aerosols, and the Argente Tower. It is a source of Separatist "shadowfeeds" (L33, L103–L107).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part I, Ch1, Part I, Ch2
  - *Agon Nine:* the planned prison world (L1201).
  - *Weytta:* Shryne's homeworld, in the same neighborhood as Murkhana (L1551).
  - *Manari:* where Shryne lost his second learner (L1563).
  - *Tion Cluster:* the smugglers' first rendezvous (L1953).
  - *Mossak:* a hub «just the other side of Felucia» (L1975).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part III, Ch18
  - *Dellalt:* where the refugee Jedi seized their transport (L2589).
  - *Jaguada's moon:* an ancient complex of winged, hooded statues, built of unidentifiable metal and possibly of ancient-Sith origin, later used by the Separatists (L2771–L2779).
  - *Coruscant/Imperial Center:* Palpatine's throne room atop the tallest building, a medical lab in its crown, and the abandoned Temple (L1843–L1847, L2079, L1883).
  - *Alderaan:* the island-city of Aldera, a Royal Palace more than seven centuries old, and Aldera University's Students of Collus (L3255, L3279, L3667). *Sern Prime:* Zar's homeworld (L3215).
  - *Kashyyyk:* wroshyr trees 300 m tall; Kachirho about 400 m (L4263, L4701). Tree-cities listed at L4649. The Wawaatt Archipelago battlefield and later prison camps (L4705, L5495). Wookiee cartographers' guild, the Claatuvac (L4231). The hrrtayyk coming-of-age ceremony (L4747).
  - *Tatooine:* Anchorhead, Tosche Station, and The Weary Traveler cantina (L5747–L5751).
- **Ships.**
  - *Gallant*, a Victory-class Star Destroyer (L31).
  - *Exactor*, «second in a line of newly minted Imperator-class» ships, 1,600 m long, built by Kuat Drive Yards, with ventral bays (L885). *Executrix* is its sister ship (L4335).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch9, Part IV, Ch37
  - Theta-class shuttle (L1051).
  - Vader's black Jedi interceptor; Sienar is building his custom fighter (L1785).
  - CloakShape with a hyperdrive booster ring; Sorosuub skiff (L1735, L1789, L1813).
  - *Dead Ringer* (L1661).
  - *Drunk Dancer*, a 20-year-old Corellian freighter with a circular command module and five gun turrets. It carries a drop ship and an Incom Relay (L1953–L1957).
  - Republic SX troop transport, later disguised as the L200 "*Vagabond Trader*" (L2397, L4179, L4285).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part I, Ch2, Part III, Ch22, Part IV, Ch36
  - Republic light cruiser (L2497); Lucrehulk wreck (L2407).
  - Recusant-class support destroyer (Commerce Guild, Gossam crew) (L5229, L5269).
  - Interdictor «Detainer CC-twenty-two hundred» (L5113).
     - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch44
  - *Tantive IV* (L3291).
- **Organizations.**
  - Ion Team commandos in Katarn-class armor (L163). The 501st (L1019). Coruscant shock troopers, «stormtroopers, as they were now being called» (L1491).

### SP6. Timeline placement and connections

**From the text**

- Ch1–8 take place in the «FINAL HOURS OF THE CLONE WARS» (L21).
- Part II begins «four standard weeks» after the war's end (L889). Vader's lightsaber is «Just three standard weeks old» (L1359).
- Kashyyyk follows Vader's last talk with Sidious by «weeks» (L4341).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch37
- The Tatooine chapter is set «months» after Obi-Wan arrived (L5753).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part IV, Ch54
- The text links to events of *Revenge of the Sith*: the four Masters in Palpatine's office, Yoda in the Rotunda, Mustafar, Polis Massa, and the Temple massacre (L891, L1901, L2699–L2711). It also mentions Grievous's cyborg rebuild «on Geonosis a decade earlier» (L2087).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch9, Part III, Ch17, Part III, Ch24, Part III, Ch19
- Forward links: the moonlet-size battle station (L1359, L4417, L5501); Vader's Sienar fighter (L1785); C-3PO's memory wipe (L3291); Luke with Owen and Beru (L5769); Obi-Wan as "Ben" (L5751); Qui-Gon's voice (L5857).
   - Chapter (added 2026-10-11, from the L-numbers above and the chapter headings in the source text): Part II, Ch13, Part IV, Ch37, Part IV, Ch50, Part II, Ch16, Part III, Ch29, Part IV, Ch54

**Outside context (not from the novel file)**

- *Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader* (James Luceno, Del Rey, 2005) is a Legends novel set just after *Revenge of the Sith*, around 19 BBY. The header of the existing notes above gives the same placement.
- The unnamed "moonlet-size" weapon is the first Death Star of *A New Hope*. Chewbacca, Tarfful, and Commander Gree appear in the *Revenge of the Sith* Kashyyyk scenes that Ch38 and Ch40 refer back to.
- Luceno's earlier *Labyrinth of Evil* (2005) leads directly into *Revenge of the Sith*, and his later *Darth Plagueis* (2012) expands on the Plagueis lore quoted here (L3237, L5541–L5549).
- Qui-Gon speaking to Obi-Wan follows Yoda's promise at the end of *Revenge of the Sith* that Obi-Wan would learn to commune with him.

## Character analyses (added 2026-10-17 under the 7+ characters rule)

*Method:* built from the verified feat log (Section 1), statements (Section 2) and the scaling table (Section 3) above, re-checked against the source. `L####` = line in `70b28ed9…txt`, with [Part/chapter] given. Quotes in «…» are verbatim and were re-checked by script. No wiki material is used. **Before:** SP2 held 4 substantial story profiles (Vader, Sidious, Shryne, Starstone) plus brief notes on 12 others, but none combined feats, fights and scaling per character. Counted as **4 partial / 0 full**. **Added:** 11 full analyses.

### 1. Darth Vader
- **Role/arc:** about four weeks after Mustafar, a clumsy, self-doubting cyborg. By Kashyyyk he has «crossed some invisible threshold to a new world.» [IV/49, L5443].
- **Key feats:** turns Ion Team's fire back and kills two [II/11, L1127–1143]. Kills Bol Chatak despite her cut to his prosthetic [II/11, L1153–1185]. On Alderaan he blocks bolts with his bare hand and his thrown saber overpowers Shryne's TK [III/34–35, L3879–3985]. Kills more than 20 Wookiees [IV/40, L4765–4773]. «Toying with the Jedi» [IV/41, L4807], he beheads Forte and Kulka and maims three more. Beats Shryne with a TK barrage after the book's longest duel [IV/43–46, L4975–5179].
- **Limits/statements:** «he could scarcely lift his arms over his head, and he had already been forced to adapt his lightsaber technique to compensate.» [II/10, L977]. «With the loss of my limbs, have I also lost strength in the Force?» [II/13, L1319]. Sidious: «he would never be able to summon lightning or leap about like the Jedi had been fond of doing.» [III/21, L2347]. He leaps repeatedly later, so this was Sidious's early read. Shryne: «A sort of black-armored version of Grievous, only more dangerous» [II/14, L1531]. Starstone: «I don't know that Vader can be stopped,» [IV/48, L5363]. Sidious holds him back «just enough to increase his apprentice's power, without making him supremely powerful.» [Epi/53, L5723].
- **Notable quotes:** «I wasn't strong enough to defeat Obi-Wan» [III/19, L2163]. «I am something to be feared.» [IV/39, L4647].
- **Scaling:** Murkhana Vader is Vader's floor (≥ a fast Master/Knight on power alone). Kashyyyk Vader is far above Knights. Clearly below Sidious in this era. See `debates-vader-vs-revan.md` and `debates-vader-vs-malgus.md`.

### 2. Darth Sidious / Emperor Palpatine
- **Role/arc:** manages Vader's self-pity, sends him to hunt, and senses his growth (Epilogue).
- **Feats:** perception, foresight and healing only. **No fights on page** (Section 3).
- **Statements:** «There is none, my son, even though your body has been crippled.» / «Together we are unconquerable.» [III/19, L2161]. «So just imagine what Yoda might have done to you.» [III/19, L2165]. «Because you know that I could easily overwhelm the delicate electrical systems of your suit.» [III/35, L4133]. Bail: «Unaided, Palpatine was capable of crushing any who opposed him.» [III/29, L3305]. Vader: «He is more powerful than you know.» [III/31, L3641]. Limit: «even Sidious hadn't foreseen Anakin's defeat by Obi-Wan Kenobi on Mustafar.» [III/21, L2313].
- **Scaling:** Sidious > early Vader (high confidence, both say so). Sidious rates a fully strong Vader above Dooku [III/19, L2157].

### 3. Roan Shryne
- **Role/arc:** a disillusioned veteran Knight with weak TK. Finds his mother, Jula, then dies against Vader so the others can escape.
- **Feats:** with clones, beats 12 sentries and 3 droids [I/3, L299–327]. Destroys 6 droids in one exchange [III/26, L2955–2993]. Lands three hits on Vader, all on prosthetics, including the lower left leg «as much to luck as to skill» [IV/46, L5141].
- **Statements:** his reads of Vader include «it was clear that Vader wasn't going to be stopped by blaster bolts» [III/34, L3961] and «lacked the strength to alter the course of Vader's lightsaber» [III/35, L4085]. And «he had to be more flesh-and-blood than cyborg, or he wouldn't have raged or been able to call on the Force with such intensity.» [IV/46, L5143].
- **Fights/results:** escapes Vader on Alderaan with blaster only. Loses at Kachirho (fatal).
- **Scaling:** an elite Knight duelist with weak TK. Clearly below Kashyyyk Vader.

### 4. Olee Starstone
- **Role/arc:** a Padawan who becomes the survivors' organizer.
- **Fights/results:** Vader is «merely allowing her to vent» [IV/41, L4817], coaches her, and lets her go [L4849]. With Chewbacca and Wookiees she beats battle droids [IV/47, L5295–5313].
- **Statement:** «I don't know that Vader can be stopped,» [L5363].
- **Scaling:** Padawan, Knight-level with a saber, far below Vader.

### 5. Bol Chatak
- **Role:** an Iridonian Zabrak Master who secretly keeps her saber and dies against Vader.
- **Feats:** her cut «melted some of the artificial ligaments that allowed the hand to pronate.» [II/13, L1315].
- **Statement:** it shakes Vader: «Only Dooku, Asajj Ventress, and Obi-Wan had been good enough with a blade to injure him» [L1317].
- **Fight/result:** Vader cuts off her arm and then beheads her.
- **Scaling:** a fast Master below even Vader at his weakest.

### 6. Siadem Forte and Iwo Kulka
- **Role:** Jedi refugees, «skilled duelists» [IV/41, L4803].
- **Fight/result:** they try the Geonosis tactic used against Dooku [L4797]. Vader toys with them and beheads both [L4807].
- **Statement:** Forte: «Master Yoda doesn't lose,» [IV/38, L4545].
- **Scaling:** a 2v1 of Knights is no threat to Kashyyyk Vader.

### 7. Climber and Ion Team
- **Role:** clone commandos who refuse Order 66 and pay for it.
- **Fight/result:** Vader kills two, and Climber is wounded by a deflected bolt [II/11, L1127–1143].
- **Scaling:** a baseline for Vader's precise bolt deflection.

### 8. Wilhuff Tarkin
- **Role:** a newly titled Moff who engineers the Kashyyyk invasion.
- **Statements:** knows «that Vader was capable of strangling him from clear across the cabin» [IV/37, L4355]. «Lord Vader, the Emperor is apprised of everything.» [IV/37, L4395].
- **Scaling:** non-Force. Included for his statements about Vader.

### 9. Bail Organa
- **Role:** realizes Vader is Anakin and hides Leia.
- **Statements:** «Perhaps Anakin's peerless strength in the Force had allowed him to survive.» [III/29, L3295]. On Palpatine (L3305, above).
- **Scaling:** non-Force.

### 10. Brudi Gayn
- **Feat/result:** his CloakShape escapes Vader's interceptor with a booster-ring trick [II/16, L1783–1823]. Vader still sees himself as the best: «he remained the galaxy's best pilot.» [L1787].
- **Scaling:** a piloting data point. Vader's loss came from the ship and timing.

### 11. Jula
- **Role:** Shryne's mother and captain of the *Drunk Dancer*. Badly wounded by Vader's thrown saber on Alderaan [III/34–35].
- **Scaling:** non-Force.
